title: Range Checker
description: Check numbers against ranges and compute merged range coverage.
writeup:
## Approach

The input contains a mix of ranges (`start-end`) and individual numbers.

## Part 1

For each number, check if it falls within any of the given ranges. Simple brute-force check against all ranges.

## Part 2

Merge all overlapping or adjacent ranges into non-overlapping intervals. Sort ranges by start, then greedily extend: if the next range overlaps or is adjacent to the current merged range, extend it. Otherwise start a new merged range. The total coverage is the sum of all merged interval lengths.
